calculation.description: Negative completed-session open-to-close return; higher values favor assets that sold off intraday, tested against next completed-session close return.

validation.regime_notes: IC/ICIR remained positive in 2020-22 (0.04811/0.14286), 2023-24 (0.05281/0.16212), 2025-26 (0.04898/0.14479), and 2027 year-to-date (0.04317/0.13393). Small 15-asset cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
